gizmo.title: Mutambo wendangariro
gizmo.description: Pidigura makadhi kuti uwane vaviri. Batanidza izwi nerevo yaro kuti kuenderana kuratidze kunzwisisa, kana shandisa mavara kana mifananidzo miviri inoenderana.

configure.title: Musoro
configure.description: Murayiridzo unoratidzwa pamusoro, semuenzaniso: Batanidza izwi nebasa raro.

configure.title: Vaviri
configure.description: Vaviri vamwe nevamwe imakadhi maviri anoenderana, kazhinji izwi nerevo yaro. Rutivi runoda mavara, mufananidzo, kana zvese.

advanced.title: Ruvara rwekusimbisa
advanced.description: Ruvara rwesarudzo rwechip yemusoro, kumashure kwemakadhi nebhatani.
